attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: A boolean indicating the disable state of the checkbox.

attributes.name: html-id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the checkbox input. Used to associate with external label elements.

attributes.name: icon-library
attributes.description: The icon library to use for the checkbox indicator.

attributes.name: icon-names
attributes.description:
The icon names to use for the checkbox indicator. Accepts an array or a comma-separated string (for example `icon-names="cross,bar"`).
The first name is for the checked state, the second for the indeterminate state.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description:
A boolean indicating the indeterminate state of the checkbox (shows a dash/minus sign).
This is part of the native HTML checkbox API for mixed/partial selection states.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label text displayed next to the checkbox. It also provides the checkbox's accessible name.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: A string representing the name of the checkbox for form submission.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: A boolean indicating whether the field is required.

attributes.name: validation-message
attributes.description: Optional custom validity message. When set to a non-empty string, the field is invalid.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: A string representing the value of the checkbox for form submission.
